neuroplasticity.title: Brain Plasticity and Development
neuroplasticity.description: The brain remains plastic throughout life, meaning that intervention can be effective at any age. Early intervention is most effective, but adults can also improve reading skills with targeted training.
keyPoints: Neural circuits for reading can be reshaped with intervention
Left hemisphere language areas can show increased activation after training
White matter connectivity can improve with intensive training
The brain's plasticity means outcomes are not fixed

disclaimer: Developmental trajectories vary widely among individuals. These milestones represent general patterns from research, not deterministic predictions. Individual assessment and personalized intervention are essential.
